title: Mad World
hook: One *bright note* makes Mad World haunting

chords.name: D
chords.text: *D*, the ♭VII. Still dark, still in the key.

chords.name: A
chords.text: The trick: *A major*, not minor. That *C♯* is Dorian.

chords.name: Em
chords.text: Back to E minor. *One bright note* is what haunts.
